implementation_choices.records: append-only revisions; separate prompt/mark/measurement/write; no timestamp from mtime
implementation_choices.time: explicit clock domains; independent anchors only; unknown uncertainty remains unknown
implementation_choices.alignment: as-of original frozen legal state; no extrapolation past original validity; interval range only if fully covered in one strict segment
implementation_choices.reference: one explicitly predeclared record per run/site/session; no phase rescale or fitted time shift
implementation_choices.cues: background +30/+120; sparse +180 and actual end +30/+120; precontinuous preceding idle +270; continuous +60 and actual end +30/+120/+300; optional medium actual start boundary and actual end +30/+120/+300
implementation_choices.late_cues: never replay past due points on normal startup; grace 5s; minimum30s merges/dedup, cap14; no missed-measurement retry
implementation_choices.model_truth: Tf A-long is TJ estimate; causal Tf is observed anchor; Ts/LP are latent; surface reference not Ts truth
implementation_choices.empty_measurements: not_measured report with telemetry/coverage; physical_mapping_validated false
implementation_choices.images: local byte copy + SHA; no OCR/color/radiometric inference; capture metadata time separate from diagnostic mtime
